queue.source: You, talking to camera. About 60 seconds.
queue.hook: Why you're tired on days you did nothing
queue.script:
1. Something you need to know: most of what wears you out isn't the work. It's everything you're carrying that nobody sees.
2. Why you need to know it: the reminders, the worrying, remembering for everyone. Your mind never gets a day off, so you feel tired even on slow days.
3. How this helps you: tonight, write down three things you're carrying. Pick one you can set down this week. Just one.
queue.caption:
Your mind keeps a list nobody else can see. Tonight, write down three things you're carrying and pick one to set down this week. 🎙️
